changes.comment: Add registerPhysics to register the components without loading the engine, PhysicsWorld.simulationEnabled, and worlds that follow Scene.physicsSettings.
Add getColliderOutline and getColliderOutlineKey: collider shapes as the simulation builds them, for tools to draw.
Add initial linear and angular velocity to RigidBody.
Add Vehicle and Wheel components: ray cast vehicles with suspension, steering, brakes and configurable drive.
